# DUDUBAO

> DUDUBAO is a magnetic toy manufacturer offering OEM, private-label and project-based ODM services.

Use the company facts page for the featured-set fact summary; piece counts include listed accessories rather than magnetic tiles alone.
MOQ, samples, lead times, payment and freight terms require project confirmation; this index states no commercial commitments.
Product selection and any testing evidence must be checked against the selected configuration and destination market.

## Company and sourcing

- [Home](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/): Introduces DUDUBAO and its magnetic toy product platforms.
- [DUDUBAO at a glance](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/company-facts.html): Summarizes the company, product lines, verified facts for five featured sets, customization scope and inquiry route.
- [OEM and private label](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/oem-magnetic-tiles.html): Explains customization options and the project inquiry process for selected products.
- [Wholesale sourcing](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/wholesale.html): Introduces sourcing discussions for distributors and retailers.
- [Inside the factory](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/factory.html): Describes molding, magnet assembly, printing, checks and packing.
- [Quality and documentation](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/quality-certification.html): Explains how to discuss product-specific and market-specific documentation needs.
- [Sourcing FAQ](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/faq.html): Organizes common sourcing questions for project discussions.

## Five featured products

- [D01-C — Rainbow Creative Pack](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/products/d01-magnetic-tiles.html): D01-C is a 102-piece Rainbow Creative Pack.
- [D10-C — Rainbow Family Pack](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/products/d10-c-large-magnetic-tiles.html): D10-C is a 219-piece Rainbow Family Pack.
- [A01-T — Transparent Tubes Ball Run Pack](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/products/a01-t-magnetic-marble-run.html): A01-T is a 119-piece Transparent Tubes Ball Run Pack.
- [A03-T — Transparent Tubes Bell Marble Run Pack](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/products/a03-t-bell-ball-run.html): A03-T is a 73-piece Transparent Tubes Bell Marble Run Pack.
- [C01-C — Rainbow Car Track Pack](https://www.dudubaotoys.com/products/c01-c-rainbow-car-track.html): C01-C is a 99-piece Rainbow Car Track Pack.
